Stanmore to Buy Moranbah South Coal Project From Exxaro For $105 Million
Stanmore Resources said it has agreed to buy the Moranbah South coal-project tenements in Australia's Queensland state from Exxaro Resources for $105 million.

The Moranbah South coal project is located adjacent to both Stanmore's Eagle Downs project and the Isaac Plains Complex, adding further resources expected to be of premium hard coking coal quality to its portfolio, the miner said.

"The acquisition of the Moranbah South tenements will represent a significant milestone for Stanmore's development portfolio, increasing our resource base and strengthening the platform to deliver on our future growth aspirations," said Chief Executive Marcelo Matos.

The deal is conditional on Exxaro first buying the 50% stake in the tenements held by joint venture partner Anglo American. Exxaro has exercised its joint venture pre-emptive rights to acquire Anglo American's interest.
Stanmore said it expects the deal to be completed before the end of the fourth quarter.
